blog.statement: We plan to release source for the MAX plugins for other chips, including Qualcomm Dragonfly and Google TPU, in the coming months.

demonstration.note: Author-reported social post. No public source, compiler profile or build recipe was located in the pinned Modular tree or by a public web search; the speed is not a Quenderin measurement.

artifact.note: The official GGUF is pinned in the catalog. No reviewed MEF conversion, weight mapping, tokenizer contract or KV-cache contract exists.

prerequisites.detail: The pinned 26.7 source contains no Android, Adreno, Qualcomm, Hexagon, QNN or Dragonfly path. The official statement defers those plugins.
A Bonsai 2B MEF plus exact tokenizer, sampling, stop and multi-turn cache mapping with publisher checksums is required.
Mobile redistribution is unreviewed. Published wheel terms differ from the source tag's Community License and no mobile package exists.
Telemetry and crash reporting must be proven disabled in the exact mobile runtime before any device execution.
arm64 JNI, API level, driver dependencies, 16 KiB alignment and optional-load fallback must be built and verified on a hosted runner.
MAX's Apple Silicon Metal implementation is a macOS host target; it is not an iOS application artifact.
On-device generation, memory, thermal, sustained speed and rendered UI are unverified. The standing restriction forbids device and simulator runs.
